verdict.rationale: Wise documents receiving payments in 40+ currencies via 'global account details' tied to its multi-currency account (wise-docs-3, wise-docs-9, wise-docs-12, wise-docs-25). Community reports independently confirm that Wise Business accounts come with USD account details clients pay into. Those same reports describe the USD details being changed with zero-day notice, which is a stability caveat rather than a contradiction of the capability (wise-comm-3, wise-comm-5). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which currencies come with local (vs. SWIFT) receiving details, explicit 'local account details' wording, and evidence that account details stay stable for founders with long payment terms.
